title: Chronicle Cryptogram
shortDescription: Daily 1920s newspaper cryptograms. Break the cipher, keep your streak.
developerPromotionalText: OrangeTopGames makes ad-free puzzle games. Chronicle Cryptogram: 1920s newspaper cryptograms and a serialized mystery.

contentRating.expected: Retake IARC in Play Console with these answers; do not file Everyone until the questionnaire returns a rating
contentRating.notes: Serialized 1920s mystery. Implied crime in newspaper text. No graphic violence, no UGC, no purchases.

dataCollected.note: Google display name when signed in
Firebase Auth UID from anonymous session or Google sign-in
Puzzle starts, solves, times, hints, leaderboard stats in Firestore under the auth UID; also stored locally
FCM token in Firestore dispatchTokens when subscribed to Morning Dispatch

securityPractices: Signed-in players can delete cloud records from Bureau File; leftover requests: justinalandial@gmail.com

graphics.icon: mobile/store/icon.png (512x512, framed tile inset so Play's rounded mask does not clip the border). Android launcher uses mobile/assets/android-icon-foreground.png (tile inset so the frame survives circular masks).
graphics.developerHeader: public/orang-top-games-header.png (4096x2304 Play developer page header; 512x512 logo centered on black)

release.artifact: AAB from eas build --platform android --profile production
release.adi: If Play Console asks for package ownership, set ADI_REGISTRATION_TOKEN and run eas build --platform android --profile adi
release.afterFirstEasBuild: Run eas credentials -p android, copy the upload keystore SHA-1 and SHA-256 into Firebase Android app Chronicle Cryptogram, then also add Play App Signing SHA-1/256 from Play Console after the first AAB upload.
